task: Keep a searchable notebook on this computer

x-display.title: Keep a searchable notebook
x-display.summary: Write and find notes in a local notebook through your browser.
x-display.description: Keep short ideas, working notes and references in a notebook you can return to. This recipe opens Memos as an ongoing application; you create and manage the notes inside the app.

packaging_note: Use the upstream service with a named notebook volume and a loopback page.

access.why: The service uses a container network to serve its local address.

known_issues: On first use, create the local owner account on the sign-up page.
